sensitivity_classification_assigned.title: Sensitivity Classification Assigned
sensitivity_classification_assigned.description: Indicates whether DNS zone files and configuration records have been formally assigned a sensitivity classification label (e.g., Internal Confidential, Restricted).

data_handling_policy_tier.title: Data Handling Policy Tier Applied
data_handling_policy_tier.description: The data handling policy tier currently applied to DNS zone files and configuration records, reflecting how access, sharing, retention, and disposal are governed.

zone_transfer_acl_type.title: Zone Transfer ACL Type
zone_transfer_acl_type.description: Indicates whether zone transfer (AXFR/IXFR) is restricted to specific authorized secondaries, open to any host, or disabled. Also reflects whether explicit access controls restrict zone transfer initiation.

dns_record_retention_policy_defined.title: DNS Record Retention Policy Defined
dns_record_retention_policy_defined.description: Whether a formal, documented retention schedule exists for DNS zone files and records, specifying maximum retention periods, triggers for removal of decommissioned host/service records, and disposal procedures.

stale_dns_record_count.title: Stale DNS Record Count
stale_dns_record_count.description: Number of DNS records in the zone that reference hosts, services, or IP ranges confirmed as decommissioned or no longer operational.

automated_decommission_dns_cleanup_enabl.title: Automated DNS Cleanup on Decommission Enabled
automated_decommission_dns_cleanup_enabl.description: Whether an automated process (e.g., ITSM integration, CI/CD pipeline, or infrastructure-as-code enforcement) removes or flags DNS records when the associated host or service is decommissioned.

zone_file_encryption_at_rest_enabled.title: Zone File Encryption at Rest Enabled
zone_file_encryption_at_rest_enabled.description: Whether backup copies, exported zone file snapshots, and zone files at rest are encrypted on the storage medium (filesystem, backup media, or object storage).

zone_snapshot_access_restricted_to_autho.title: Zone Snapshot Access Restricted to Authorized Roles
zone_snapshot_access_restricted_to_autho.description: Whether access to the storage location containing zone file snapshots is restricted to explicitly authorized roles or accounts via access controls (filesystem permissions, IAM policies, ACLs).

zone_access_scope.title: Zone Data Access Scope
zone_access_scope.description: Indicates whether access controls on DNS zone data are scoped to specific record subsets (need-to-know) or grant read access to entire zone files.

broad_permission_group_contains_service_.title: Service Accounts in Broad Zone Read Group
broad_permission_group_contains_service_.description: Whether service accounts or automated scripts are members of the broad zone read permission group, increasing the blast radius of a compromise.

dns_log_anonymization_enabled.title: DNS Log Anonymization Enabled
dns_log_anonymization_enabled.description: Whether DNS query logs and diagnostic exports have hostname and internal IP address anonymization or masking applied before export to third-party platforms or log aggregation systems.

dns_logs_shared_with_third_party.title: DNS Logs Shared with Third-Party Vendor
dns_logs_shared_with_third_party.description: Whether DNS query logs or diagnostic exports containing resolved hostnames and/or internal IP addresses are transmitted to third-party monitoring vendors or external log aggregation platforms.

third_party_data_sharing_control_exists.title: Third-Party Data Sharing Control Exists
third_party_data_sharing_control_exists.description: Whether a formal cross-boundary or third-party data-sharing control (such as a DPA, data classification agreement, or technical access control) governs the export of DNS log data to external parties.

formal_dns_disposal_procedure_documented.title: Formal DNS Record Disposal Procedure Documented
formal_dns_disposal_procedure_documented.description: Indicates whether a documented, approved procedure exists for purging decommissioned DNS records and associated zone data from all storage locations (live DNS, backups, audit logs, exported copies), including a backup purge schedule.
